description: This file defines an interface for interacting with agent nodes, along with related data structures such as responses and custom time handling. It includes methods for health checks, server management, status retrieval, and shutdown procedures, primarily serving as a communication contract and data models for an agent management system.

classes.name: AgentClient
classes.description: Interface defining methods for communicating with agent nodes, including health checks, server control, status retrieval, and shutdown.

classes.name: MCPHealthResponse
classes.description: Represents the health data collected from MCP servers on an agent node.

classes.name: FlexibleTime
classes.description: Custom time type handling JSON unmarshaling of timestamps with or without timezone.

classes.name: MCPServerHealth
classes.description: Details the health status of a specific MCP server managed by an agent.

classes.name: MCPSummary
classes.description: Aggregated summary metrics for MCP health status across multiple servers.

classes.name: MCPToolsResponse
classes.description: Contains the list of tools available from an MCP server.

classes.name: MCPTool
classes.description: Data model for individual MCP tools, including name, description, and input schema.

classes.name: MCPRestartResponse
classes.description: Response structure for MCP server restart requests.

classes.name: AgentShutdownResponse
classes.description: Response structure for agent shutdown requests, including status, timing, and messages.

classes.name: AgentStatusResponse
classes.description: Provides detailed status information about an agent node.

methods.name: GetMCPHealth
methods.description: Retrieves MCP health information from an agent node.

methods.name: RestartMCPServer
methods.description: Restarts a specific MCP server on an agent node.

methods.name: GetMCPTools
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tools from a specific MCP server.

methods.name: ShutdownAgent
methods.description: Requests a graceful shutdown of an agent node via HTTP.

methods.name: GetAgentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves detailed status information from an agent node.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom unmarshaling implementation for FlexibleTime to parse various timestamp formats.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom marshaling for FlexibleTime to output RFC3339Nano formatted string.
